## Notes

- Cloudflare Worker that renders Open Graph images with [`@cf-wasm/og`](https://github.com/fineshopdesign/cf-wasm).
- Entry point is `src/index.ts`. Image rendering lives in `src/image.tsx`; Worker config lives in `wrangler.jsonc`.
- Rendered images are cached in an R2 bucket (`OG_BUCKET`) and at the edge. The cache key is order-independent on query params, so the same params in any order resolve to one object.
- `pnpm dev` runs `wrangler dev`; `pnpm cf:deploy` deploys the worker.
